evidence_type: paired randomized MuJoCo simulation; not hardware evidence

target_sampling.distribution: independent uniform XY samples in a square

camera_pipeline.detector: unchanged default red HSV contour detector from run.py
camera_pipeline.projection: shared pixel_to_table_xy pinhole helper from controller.py

task_success_definition.physical_stable_lift_success: free payload remains at least 7 cm above start for 1.6 s, has at least three finger-pad contacts, stays within 5 degrees tilt, respects 1 mm inter-arm penetration limit, and has no unexpected arm contacts

limitations: The controller estimates a static target pose once at planning time; it does not servo on later images.
The camera uses ideal intrinsics and no lens distortion, noise, lighting shift, clutter, or occlusion.
The default detector is used; the opt-in circle-prior detector remains experimental and is not promoted.
The oracle condition isolates position-estimation effects and is not a deployable controller.
Physical stable-lift success is not fresh visual confirmation or real-robot performance.
Same-arm self-collision remains suppressed by the shared scene masks.
